cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Admit What You Wanted
cards.instruction: Maneuver them into revealing which outcome they truly wanted before you explain your own stake.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Which job offer did you secretly want me to accept?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Before you knew which one made me happy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Because I haven't told you what I chose, and this is our last unbiased minute.

mechanism: A supervises a pre-disclosure answer to obtain B's genuine job preference before showing A's own decision.
confusable: D198 measures rank/incentives; D208 specifically obtains desired outcome before disclosure.
comparison: Close relationship and moving decision differ from an election result discussion.
seedUse: Keep whichever-happy evasion; specify job options and make the unbiased minute an actual choice task.
